outcome: Indications for cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery
cohort: Nulliparous women reaching complete cervical dilation with singleton gestations 36 weeks or greater
finding: While second-stage duration remained consistent, nulliparous women in the later cohort (2011-2012) were twice as likely to undergo cesarean delivery and half as likely to undergo operative vaginal delivery compared to the earlier cohort (2000-2003).
mod_finding: Nulliparous women in the later cohort (2011-2012) were twice as likely to undergo cesarean delivery and half as likely to undergo operative vaginal delivery compared to the earlier cohort (2000-2003).
